chunks: ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUtbah al-Hāshimī asked Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام:
About an elderly man and an elderly woman who becomes too weak to fast in the month of Ramadan, he عليه السلام said: “He gives charity for each day a mudd of wheat.”

key_terms.الشَّيْخِ الْكَبِيرِ: an elderly man advanced in age
key_terms.الْعَجُوزِ الْكَبِيرَةِ: an elderly woman advanced in age
key_terms.مُدٍّ: a mudd, a known measure of food

ai.seo_question: What should an elderly person who cannot fast in Ramadan give for each missed day?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for elderly persons who are too weak to observe sawm in the month of Ramadan. It states that for each missed day, a mudd of wheat is to be given in charity as compensation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1951 - Abd al-Malik ibn Utbah al-Hashimi asked Abu al-Hasan (as) about an elderly man and an elderly woman who are too weak to fast during the Month of Ramadan.
Imam (as) said: "They should give a mudd (a specific measure) of wheat as charity for each day."
